mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO session_examiners (session_id, examiner_id, assigned_at, assigned_by) VALUES
(#{e.sessionId}, #{e.examinerId}, #{e.assignedAt}, #{e.assignedBy})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE assigned_at = VALUES(assigned_at), assigned_by = VALUES(assigned_by)
mapper.select: SELECT ss.session_id FROM session_examiners se JOIN slot_sessions ss ON ss.session_id = se.session_id WHERE se.examiner_id = #{examinerId} AND NOT (ss.end_at <= #{startAt} OR ss.start_at >= #{endAt})
